text: Teresa is having her knee operation on 14 November. She's nervous about the anaesthetic more than anything. Remind me to text her the night before.

Arturo and Isabel fly to Lima on the 3rd of December for three weeks. First time back since his dad passed, so it'll be a lot. They're spending Christmas with his aunt in Arequipa and then a week on the coast if Isabel's back holds up. She's been seeing a physio since the summer and is worried about the long-haul flight. I should send her that travel pillow link before they go.
Just back from coffee with Natasha. She's finally found a flat in Leeds, two bedrooms near the station, and moves in at the end of the month. Her cat Biscuit is going to hate the drive.
Joseph's mum had a fall last week and is still in St James's. He's going up to see her every evening after work and looks shattered.
Need to book the car in for its MOT sometime next week.

Oisín says the Lisbon trip is off. Work wouldn't let him take the time. He's going to try for early March instead. He sounded properly gutted, to be honest. They'd booked the flights and a place in Alfama, and his girlfriend Aaliyah had already sorted her leave. Hopefully they get some of the money back. Ask him about it sometime next week once he's had a chance to call the airline.
Ahmed starts his new job in Manchester on 6 January. He's still looking for somewhere to live, probably a room in a shared house to begin with.
Lachlan Hughes, Lachie to everyone, is back from Sydney. Thirty hours door to door and he swears never again. His sister Kiara is staying out there until Easter.
Don't forget to ask Tendai how the scan went on Thursday.
Yetunde is allergic to penicillin, which only came out because of the infection after her wisdom teeth.
Rang Joy about the move. They've exchanged and complete on 28/11. She wants help packing the weekend before, and I've said I'll bring the van.
Dalia's husband Tiago had his gallbladder out yesterday. Home already, but not allowed to drive for a couple of weeks. I should drop off a lasagne on Saturday.

Adaeze and her partner are going to Japan over the summer. She's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for a year and is very proud of her streak. They land in Tokyo on 20 July, then a week in Kyoto and a few days in Hokkaido at the end. Her partner wants to do the Kumano Kodo walk too, which she's less keen on. She asked if I still had the rail pass info from my trip, so I need to dig that out and forward it.

Giulia mentioned her dad's hip replacement is booked for 22 January in Bologna. She'll fly out a few days before and stay for most of February to look after him. Her brother Rafael can't get time off, so it's all on her, and she sounded pretty worn out just talking about it. Must check in with her when she's out there.
Mustafa got the keys to the new place today!
Tobi has a viewing on Saturday at 11 for a flat in Bermondsey. If it goes well he'll put an offer in straight away.
Liam's flight to Toronto was cancelled so he's stuck in Dublin overnight. Rebooked for tomorrow at 9.
Alejandro hates flying. Always takes the train if he can, even to Barcelona.
Gustavo has been signed off for six weeks after his back surgery. Remind me to call him next Tuesday.
Pooja is moving to Bristol in early April to be closer to her parents. Her mum hasn't been well since the stroke.
Anika's son Liam is off on his gap year on 9 February, starting in Vietnam. She's trying very hard not to cry about it.
Note to self: renew passport before the end of the month. Expires in June and Morocco needs six months left on it.
Aaliyah had her cataract operation this morning. Her daughter drove her. All fine apparently, but she has to wear the shield at night for a week.
Isabel's birthday is on 2nd of March. She keeps talking about a decent suitcase, the hard-shell kind. Worth remembering.
Thomas and his wife are selling up and moving to Cornwall sometime in the spring. They've got a buyer but nothing to move into yet.

Duc's grandmother is flying in from Hanoi on 15 December for a month. First visit in eight years. He's repainting the spare room for her and has bought a proper mattress because she has a bad back. His mum is in charge of the cooking, obviously. He's nervous about how she'll cope with the cold, since she's never seen a British winter. They're hoping to take her up to see the Christmas lights in York over the holidays.
Beatriz is waiting on biopsy results, should hear by the end of next week. She's trying to stay busy. I need to message her on Friday and see if she wants company.
Saw Marta at the school gates. They're back from Crete and the kids are already asking about next summer.
Tamar is a nurse on the cardiac ward at the Royal Free. Twelve-hour shifts, mostly nights at the moment.
Rafael leaves for his month in Patagonia on 4 March. He's going to try to do the W Trek on his own.
Ahmed said his landlord has finally agreed to fix the damp. The bathroom ceiling has been black since August.

Call with Natasha and Joseph about Dad's surgery. It's moved to 30 October now, at the Nuffield. Natasha will take him in, Joseph will collect, and I'm doing the first week of visits. Need to sort out a rota for meals for when he's home and ask the surgery about the physio referral. He's being very stoic about it but Natasha thinks he's quite scared.
Remember to send Oisín the Airbnb link for Porto.
Kiara's moving into her first flat on her own next month. She's excited and a bit terrified. A plant or a nice set of mugs would go down well as a housewarming present.
Teresa's knee op went well. She's on crutches for six weeks and already bored out of her mind. I should pop round with some books at the weekend.
Lachlan's dog Moose had to have a tooth out last week. He's fine, Lachie was a wreck.
Dentist moved to 12/11 at 8.40.

Tendai's scan was clear. Huge relief all round. She's taking her mum to Victoria Falls in May to celebrate. She's waited about four months for that result and the last fortnight was awful, she said she couldn't sleep at all. Her partner Ahmed has been brilliant apparently. Need to send her a card, something cheerful, and maybe a guidebook for Zimbabwe as a little extra.
Joy's husband Duc has been offered a job in Edinburgh. They're thinking about it, but she doesn't want to move the girls mid-year.
Arturo got back from Peru on Sunday. Isabel picked up some bug on the last day and is still in bed. Text her later.
Gustavo prefers it if people don't phone during the day, he's sleeping a lot. Messages are fine.
Giulia flew out this morning. Her dad goes in on the 22nd. I must message her that day to see how it went.
Mustafa is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Keep in mind for the housewarming.
Tobi's offer was accepted! Completion is pencilled in for mid-January if the chain holds. He's already measuring up for a sofa.
Pooja's mum is back in hospital, a second, smaller stroke. Pooja is driving down tonight. Ring her tomorrow evening, not before.
Booked the flights to Marrakech for 18 April, back on the 25th. Hotel still to sort.
Adaeze is a structural engineer at Arup. She's into bouldering and goes three times a week.
Liam made it to Toronto eventually. His cousin's wedding is on Saturday and he's doing a reading, which he's dreading.
Rafael's girlfriend Beatriz is not thrilled about Patagonia. She thinks going alone in March is reckless. He's promised to check in every few days by satellite phone.

Long chat with Thomas. The sale of their house fell through on Friday, so Cornwall's on hold for now. Their son Tobi is relieved because he didn't want to change schools anyway. Thomas is taking it well, his wife less so. They'll relist after Christmas.
Yetunde's off to Lagos for her sister's wedding on 12 December. Ten days. She's bringing back fabric for me.
Remind me to ask Anika if Liam landed safely.
Dalia says Tiago is up and about again and back at work on Monday. Their cat Pistachio slept on him the whole time he was recovering.
Haven't heard from Joseph since his mum came home. Must ring him this week.
Tamar's moving in with her girlfriend Marta at the start of December. They've found a place in Kentish Town with a garden, which Tamar has wanted forever.
Isabel is fully recovered. They're already planning Mexico for next October.
Duc says his grandmother's flight lands at 6.15 on the 15th. He's asked if I can help at the airport because she uses a wheelchair. Said yes.

Oisín's Porto trip is now 7th to 11th of March. He's going with his brother Lachlan and their dad, who's turning seventy that week. Big family thing. I said I'd recommend somewhere for dinner, so need to dig out that list from last year and send it to him before the end of February.
Alejandro's mother has been in hospital since Sunday with pneumonia. He's flying to Valencia on Wednesday. Remind me to message him on Thursday.
Clear out the loft before the estate agent comes round on 3 November.
